title: tephrosia carrollii
intro: Tephrosia carrollii, commonly known as the Carroll's horsefly or Horsefly pea, is a plant species that belongs to the Fabaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Tephrosia carrollii include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it a valuable natural remedy for cardiovascular and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing oxidative stress, improving cardiovascular health, and modulating the immune system.
